title: The Productivity Illusion: Why AI is Breaking Your Engineering KPIs
description:
Engineering dashboards look greener than ever in the age of AI-generated code, yet incidents, review queues and developer burnout keep rising. This episode helps engineering leaders and IT decision makers see through the productivity illusion and shows which flow, quality, cognitive load and value metrics reveal what is really happening.
In this episode
00:00 – The hallucination of speed09:18 – Activity versus systemic flow13:21 – The cognitive load crisis17:06 – The toxic KPI trap20:13 – From DORA 4 to DORA 5: rework rate34:28 – The governance bottleneck and the burnout signal47:44 – The diagnostic dashboard55:48 – The organizational shift and the roadmap
Key takeaways
AI has moved the engineering bottleneck from writing code to reviewing, testing and governing it, so activity metrics like deployment frequency look better while stability, incidents and rework get worse.Rework rate, decomposed lead time, flow efficiency and cognitive load reveal system health far better than the classic four DORA metrics alone.Metrics should be diagnostic questions owned by teams and never used for individual performance, with changes introduced as measured experiments through a phased roadmap.

Episode page: the full episode with chapters, the metric breakdown and FAQGovernance – the new AI code review gates that lengthen lead time and must be made explicitHuman in the loop – a dashboard metric checking whether human review really catches the problems AI code createsCompliance – one of the extra checks AI-generated code passes before production, adding waiting timeRelated episode: Beyond Copilot: Building Enterprise AI Agents That Actually Work with Copilot Studio with Manpreet Singh [MVP-MCT]
